# Enable 2FA for your favorite sites.

Go beyond the password and protect yourself from hackers and account takeovers. Download our free
app:

[ Download Authy ][10]

## Two-factor authentication (2FA) is the best way to protect yourself online.

Defeat cyber criminals & avoid account takeovers with stronger security, for free! Watch the video
below to learn more about why you should enable 2FA for your accounts.

[Star outline]

###### Top Rated Authenticator App

Simple to setup, secure cloud backup, multi device support.

[ App features ][11]
[Settings icon]

Need help? We'd love to hear from you.

[ Get help ][12]
[A newspaper article]

### Why use Two-Factor Authentication

Relying on just usernames and passwords to secure your online accounts is no longer considered safe.
Data breaches occur daily and hackers are always inventing new ways to take over your accounts.
Protect yourself by enabling two-factor authentication (2FA). This blocks anyone using your stolen
data by verifying your identity through your device. Enable 2FA now to protect your accounts online.

# Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification | ACSMI Online Training

The [Advanced Cybersecurity Management Institute (ACSMI)][90] provides professional cybersecurity
certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

Earn your Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification (ACSMC) through our CPD-accredited and
ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

[ Start Your Cybersecurity Journey ][93]
[ [Advertisement for an online multi-domain cybersecurity training program offering advanced
cybersecurity and management certification with a red 'Enroll Instantly' button, logos, and trainer
photos.] ][94]

**✔** 300+ Interactive Bite-sized Lessons Covering All Major Cybersecurity Domains
**✔** Led by Janero Washington with 10+ Years of Cybersecurity Teaching Expertise
**✔** Risk-Free 14-Day Refund, Lifetime Access, Flexible Payment Plans & Mentorship
**✔** Real-World Cybersecurity Cases, Labs, Simulations, and Capstone

Fortify endpoints, cloud-native apps, containers, and serverless architectures against relentless

Detect, isolate, and eradicate advanced threats with real-world APT simulations and machine-learning

## Why Choose ACSMI's Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification?

[tick icon]

**Advanced cybersecurity training** online covering every major certification framework

[tick icon]

**14-Day Refund Guarantee** — enroll risk-free.

`Career Opportunities`

### ASCMI’s Certification Will Get You Practical Skills That Set You Apart

Hiring managers don’t want memorized facts. They want proven defenders.You’ll graduate with a
portfolio, a toolkit, and the battle scars that prove you’re ready to own a cybersecurity career.
* #### CTF Challenges
  
  Capture the flag scenarios that sharpen real-time hacking and defense instincts.
* #### Capstone Breach Simulation
  
  Architect an enterprise defense, survive a full-scale attack, and prove your strategy in a
  simulated boardroom defense briefing.
* #### SIEM and Threat Hunting Labs
  
  Master tools like Splunk and Elastic for threat detection, response, and proactive hunting.
* #### Penetration Testing Playbooks
  
  Go beyond theory with full-scope penetration testing across cloud, mobile, network, and IoT
  landscapes.
* #### Cloud Security Deployments
  
  Build multi-layered defenses in AWS, Azure, and hybrid clouds with live case studies.

[ ➔ Get Started ][97]

`how it works`

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

`What You Will Learn`

## How You’ll Learn: Fast-Track or Flex Through ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification

Your life isn’t on pause, and your career ambitions shouldn’t be either. That’s why ACSMI’s Advanced
Cybersecurity & Management Certification gives you complete control over your timeline:

Both tracks deliver **the same powerhouse curriculum**, labs, capstone defense, and certification
preparation, just built around your reality, not someone else's.

[Fast-Track Option]

Fast-Track Option

Complete your full certification in as little as **8 weeks** through an intensive, structured
bootcamp experience, perfect for career changers and go-getters ready to dive in.

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

Self-Paced Flexibility

Need balance? Take **3–6 months** to work through the curriculum around your job, family, or
existing studies, with no deadlines locking you down.

`Who Needs Us`

### Who ACSMI’s Dual Cybersecurity & Management Certification Is Built For

Cybersecurity has no one-size-fits-all, and neither does ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
Certification. Wherever you're starting, ACSMI doesn’t just prepare you for a cybersecurity job —
**it prepares you to lead the future of security itself.**

[College Graduates]

#### **College Graduates**

Launch your career with leadership-grade credentials and skills that outpace entry-level
competition.

[Career Changers]

#### **Career Changers**

Break into cybersecurity fast with practical, recognized certification and hands-on proof you can
deliver.

[IT Professionals]

#### **IT Professionals**

Specialize and pivot toward six-figure cybersecurity roles, cloud security, ethical hacking, or
threat intelligence.

[Security Analysts]

#### **Security Analysts**

Move up from daily tasks to high-level strategic defense, threat hunting, and leadership roles.

[Aspiring CISOs]

#### **Aspiring CISOs**

Learn governance, budgeting, and security operations leadership to transition into decision-maker
roles.

`who is it for`

### Who Hires Cybersecurity Specialists With ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
### Certification?

Demand is growing across every vertical that depends on digital operations — and ACSMI-certified
professionals are equipped to lead across them all.

# Authelia

Authelia is an open-source [authentication][14] and [authorization][15] server and portal fulfilling
the identity and access management (IAM) role of information security in providing [multi-factor
authentication][16] and single sign-on (SSO) for your applications via a web portal. Authelia is an
OpenID Connect 1.0 Provider which is [OpenID Certified™][17] allowing comprehensive integrations,
and acts as a companion for [common reverse proxies][18].

[Get started][19]

Open-source Apache 2.0 Licensed. [GitHub v4.39.20][20]

## Lightweight 🪶

With a compressed container size smaller than 20 megabytes and observed memory usage normally under
30 megabytes, it's one of the most lightweight solutions available.

## Blazing Fast ⚡

Written in [Go][21] and [React][22], authorization policies and many other backend tasks are
completed in mere milliseconds and login portal loading times of 100 milliseconds makes it one of
the fastest solutions available.

## Efficient ♻

Processors can use a lot of electricity, but when idle usage is basically so low that you can't
measure it, and active usage in a small business environment being under 1% you can rest easy (with
the exclusion of password hashing).

## Security by Design 🔒

Not just another IAM portal, [security][23] is heavily considered as part of our design process.

## Login Regulation 🛡️

Prevent brute force login attempts by only allowing a [certain number of logins][24] before the user
is locked for a period.

## Password Reset 📧

Built-in support for users to reset their LDAP or internal passwords with email validation right
from the web interface.

## Single Sign-On 🎟️

Allow your users the convenience of just being required to login once to a wide range of web
applications via a session cookie, [OpenID Connect 1.0][25], or [Trusted Headers][26].

## Authorization Policies 👮

Control which users and groups have access to which specific resources or domains with incredibly
[granular policy definitions][27].

## Identity Validation ✔

Users who have not configured a second-factor device are required to validate their identity via an
email reducing the chance an attacker could exploit a lazy user.

## Scalability ⚙

Designed with high availability in mind, deployment options exist to easily allow multiple parallel
containers on lifecycle management platforms like Kubernetes.

## Multi-Factor and Passwordless Authentication 🗝️

Support for passwordless authentication via [Passkeys][28] and multiple second-factor methods
including [One Time Passwords][29], [Mobile Push Notifications][30], and [WebAuthn][31].

## Intuitive User Interface 💡

The login portal is super straight forward and the workflow is completely transparent to your users.

## Support Authelia

Help support the Authelia project obtain formal security audits and accreditations by [becoming a
financial contributor][32].

[Contribute][33]

May 18, 2025 in [News][35], [Announcements][36] by [James Elliott][37]5 minutes

### [4.39: Release Notes][38]

Authelia 4.39 has been released and the following is a guide on all the massive changes.

March 16, 2025 in [News][39], [Release Notes][40] by [James Elliott][41] and [Brynn
Crowley][42]13 minutes

### [Authelia + Traefik Setup Guide][43]

In this guide we will walk through setting up Authelia with Traefik as the reverse proxy. This guide
aims to provide an opinionated way to setup Authelia that is fully supported by the Authelia team.

January 3, 2025 in [Guides][44] by [Brynn Crowley][45]8 minutes

# Authelia

Authelia is an open-source [authentication][14] and [authorization][15] server and portal fulfilling
the identity and access management (IAM) role of information security in providing [multi-factor
authentication][16] and single sign-on (SSO) for your applications via a web portal. Authelia is an
OpenID Connect 1.0 Provider which is [OpenID Certified™][17] allowing comprehensive integrations,
and acts as a companion for [common reverse proxies][18].

[Get started][19]

Open-source Apache 2.0 Licensed. [GitHub v4.39.20][20]

## Lightweight 🪶

With a compressed container size smaller than 20 megabytes and observed memory usage normally under
30 megabytes, it's one of the most lightweight solutions available.

## Blazing Fast ⚡

Written in [Go][21] and [React][22], authorization policies and many other backend tasks are
completed in mere milliseconds and login portal loading times of 100 milliseconds makes it one of
the fastest solutions available.

## Efficient ♻

Processors can use a lot of electricity, but when idle usage is basically so low that you can't
measure it, and active usage in a small business environment being under 1% you can rest easy (with
the exclusion of password hashing).

## Security by Design 🔒

Not just another IAM portal, [security][23] is heavily considered as part of our design process.

## Login Regulation 🛡️

Prevent brute force login attempts by only allowing a [certain number of logins][24] before the user
is locked for a period.

## Password Reset 📧

Built-in support for users to reset their LDAP or internal passwords with email validation right
from the web interface.

## Single Sign-On 🎟️

Allow your users the convenience of just being required to login once to a wide range of web
applications via a session cookie, [OpenID Connect 1.0][25], or [Trusted Headers][26].

## Authorization Policies 👮

Control which users and groups have access to which specific resources or domains with incredibly
[granular policy definitions][27].

## Identity Validation ✔

Users who have not configured a second-factor device are required to validate their identity via an
email reducing the chance an attacker could exploit a lazy user.

## Scalability ⚙

Designed with high availability in mind, deployment options exist to easily allow multiple parallel
containers on lifecycle management platforms like Kubernetes.

## Multi-Factor and Passwordless Authentication 🗝️

Support for passwordless authentication via [Passkeys][28] and multiple second-factor methods
including [One Time Passwords][29], [Mobile Push Notifications][30], and [WebAuthn][31].

## Intuitive User Interface 💡

The login portal is super straight forward and the workflow is completely transparent to your users.

## Support Authelia

Help support the Authelia project obtain formal security audits and accreditations by [becoming a
financial contributor][32].

[Contribute][33]

#### Caller Verification
#### Simple. Fast. Secure.

[Call center agents]

Verify callers securely in under 10 seconds—no more annoying security questions! 

[
[Org Verify logo]
][71]
[
][72]

Caller Verify now has an OrgVerify add-on to ensure the customers, citizens and employees you call
know it is really your organization calling.

#### [To learn more][73]

##### Why caller verify?

Caller Verify extends Okta MFA to your Call Center or IT Help Desk, allowing you to quickly and
securely verify callers and [eliminate the use of annoying and weak security questions][74].  With
Caller Verify, you can enhance your callers' experience, eliminate call center fraud risk with NIST
compliant verification, reduce your average handle time to verify callers, and provide a unified
verification experience across all channels.

##### Caller Verify  outcomes

[Better Caller Experience1.png]

### User Experience

Enhance your caller's experience with a simple one touch verification. Reduce verification friction
and help your callers with their needs faster than ever.

[More Secure.png]

### More Secure

Prevent bad actors from impersonating your callers. Caller Verify leverages Okta to send a push
notification to your caller's registered phone.

[Reduced Call Times.png]

### Reduced Call Times

Reduce average handle time by verifying callers in less than 10 seconds!

[Unified Verification - Caller Verify.png]

### Unified Verification

Your brand is built on consistency and enhanced by security. Create one familiar unified experience
across online, mobile AND the Call center!

[Book a Demo ][75]

##### integrations

### ITSM

Caller Verify integrates into the ITSM systems you already use for a single pane of glass.  We have
out of the box integrations with: ServiceNow, Jira, Manage Engine, FreshService, and Zendesk.

### [CRM][76]

Caller Verify has out of the box integrations with Customer Relationship Management tools like
Salesforce.

### [IVR ][77]

Caller Verify automates caller authentication through IVR and speeds up the verification process,
minimizes wait times, and ensures consistency in how callers are validated. We have out of the box
integrations with Nice CXone and Genesys.

### Phishing-resistant Caller Verification

Leveraging phishing resistant factors such as device biometrics helps strengthen your caller
verification practices.

# CALLER VERIFY PROCESS

[Caller Verify Flow]

# VERIFICATION FACTORS

[secure factors scale]

### Branding

Caller Verify has the ability to use your brand in the push notification by leveraging Okta's SDK
functionality. 

### Business Rules

Business rules allow you to configure when you want caller verification to be required for your
business needs. 

### [Savings Calculator][78]

Contact us to try out our savings calculator to estimate the impact of secure caller verification on
your bottom line.

##### Time

#### Frequently Asked Questions
* Can Caller Verify authenticate the organization that’s calling me?
  
  Caller Verify can be integrated with [OrgVerify][87] to provide this capability.
* What’s the difference between OrgVerify and Caller Verify?
  
  OrgVerify authenticates outbound calls: it lets recipients confirm that your business or employee
  is legitimately contacting them.
  
  Caller Verify authenticates inbound calls: it verifies the identity of customers or employees who
  contact your support desk.
  
  Together, Caller Verify + OrgVerify creates trust on both ends of the line, securing inbound and
  outbound communications.
* How does Caller Verify work?
  
  Caller Verify uses real-time multi-factor authentication (MFA) to securely verify users during
  support calls.
* Which platforms does Caller Verify integrate with?
  
  Caller Verify works with your existing Okta or Auth0 IDP.  It integrates seamlessly with ITSM
  including ServiceNow, Zendesk, Jira Service Management, ManageEngine, Freshservice or IVRs like
  Genesys and NICE CXone.
* Is Caller Verify secure?
  
  Yes — it eliminates security questions and uses push notifications or one-time codes via trusted
  MFA tools.
* How quickly can Caller Verify be implemented?
  
  Caller Verify is a SaaS product. In most cases the integration of Caller Verify with your existing
  IDP, ITSM or IVR can be done in under a day.

Caller Verify now has an OrgVerify add-on to ensure the customers, citizens and employees you call
know it is really your organization calling.

#### [To learn more][73]

##### Why caller verify?

Caller Verify extends Okta MFA to your Call Center or IT Help Desk, allowing you to quickly and
securely verify callers and [eliminate the use of annoying and weak security questions][74].  With
Caller Verify, you can enhance your callers' experience, eliminate call center fraud risk with NIST
compliant verification, reduce your average handle time to verify callers, and provide a unified
verification experience across all channels.

##### Caller Verify  outcomes

[Better Caller Experience1.png]

### User Experience

Enhance your caller's experience with a simple one touch verification. Reduce verification friction
and help your callers with their needs faster than ever.

[More Secure.png]

### More Secure

Prevent bad actors from impersonating your callers. Caller Verify leverages Okta to send a push
notification to your caller's registered phone.

[Reduced Call Times.png]

### Reduced Call Times

Reduce average handle time by verifying callers in less than 10 seconds!

[Unified Verification - Caller Verify.png]

### Unified Verification

Your brand is built on consistency and enhanced by security. Create one familiar unified experience
across online, mobile AND the Call center!

[Book a Demo ][75]

##### integrations

### ITSM

Caller Verify integrates into the ITSM systems you already use for a single pane of glass.  We have
out of the box integrations with: ServiceNow, Jira, Manage Engine, FreshService, and Zendesk.

### [CRM][76]

Caller Verify has out of the box integrations with Customer Relationship Management tools like
Salesforce.

### [IVR ][77]

Caller Verify automates caller authentication through IVR and speeds up the verification process,
minimizes wait times, and ensures consistency in how callers are validated. We have out of the box
integrations with Nice CXone and Genesys.

### Phishing-resistant Caller Verification

Leveraging phishing resistant factors such as device biometrics helps strengthen your caller
verification practices.

### Branding

Caller Verify has the ability to use your brand in the push notification by leveraging Okta's SDK
functionality. 

### Business Rules

Business rules allow you to configure when you want caller verification to be required for your
business needs.

Contact us to try out our savings calculator to estimate the impact of secure caller verification on
your bottom line.

##### Time Savings

Our solution verifies callers in less than 10 seconds, reducing average handle time and enabling you
to assist callers more efficiently.

## Quick time to value

The ITSM and IVR integrations typically require 1-3 days of effort.

The stand-alone SaaS integration of Caller Verify can be set up in less than a day!

## Supported factors

* Okta Verify

authentication, and improve operational efficiency.

#### Frequently Asked Questions
* Can Caller Verify authenticate the organization that’s calling me?
  
  Caller Verify can be integrated with [OrgVerify][87] to provide this capability.
* What’s the difference between OrgVerify and Caller Verify?
  
  OrgVerify authenticates outbound calls: it lets recipients confirm that your business or employee
  is legitimately contacting them.
  
  Caller Verify authenticates inbound calls: it verifies the identity of customers or employees who
  contact your support desk.
  
  Together, Caller Verify + OrgVerify creates trust on both ends of the line, securing inbound and
  outbound communications.
* How does Caller Verify work?
  
  Caller Verify uses real-time multi-factor authentication (MFA) to securely verify users during
  support calls.
* Which platforms does Caller Verify integrate with?
  
  Caller Verify works with your existing Okta or Auth0 IDP.  It integrates seamlessly with ITSM
  including ServiceNow, Zendesk, Jira Service Management, ManageEngine, Freshservice or IVRs like
  Genesys and NICE CXone.
* Is Caller Verify secure?
  
  Yes — it eliminates security questions and uses push notifications or one-time codes via trusted
  MFA tools.
* How quickly can Caller Verify be implemented?
  
  Caller Verify is a SaaS product. In most cases the integration of Caller Verify with your existing
  IDP, ITSM or IVR can be done in under a day.

## How does a VPN work?

To understand how a VPN works, it helps to first understand how your internet connection works
without one.

### Without a VPN

When you access a website without a VPN, you are being connected to that site through your internet
service provider, or ISP. The ISP assigns you a **unique IP address** that can be used to identify
you to the website. Because your ISP is handling and directing all your traffic, it can see which
websites you visit. And your activity can be linked to you by that unique IP address.

### With a VPN

When you connect to the internet with a VPN, the VPN app on your device (also called a **VPN
client**) establishes a secure connection with a **VPN server**. Your traffic still passes through
your ISP, but your ISP can no longer read it or see its final destination. The websites you visit
can no longer see your original IP address, only the IP address of the VPN server, which is shared
by many other users and changes regularly.

Here are several key concepts related to VPN that will help you understand how a VPN works and the
benefits it provides:

### Proxying

The VPN server acts like a **proxy**, or stand-in, for your web activity: Instead of your real IP
address and location, websites you visit will only see the IP address and location of the VPN
server.

This makes you more **anonymous** on the internet.

### Authentication

Establishing a secure connection is a tricky problem solved by clever mathematics in a process
called **authentication**.

Once authenticated, the VPN client and VPN server can be sure they are talking to each other and no
one else.

### Tunneling

VPNs also protect the connection between client and server with tunneling and encryption.

Tunneling is a process by which each data packet is **encapsulated** inside another data packet.
This makes it harder for third parties to read in transit.

### Encryption

Data inside the tunnel is also **encrypted** in such a way that only the intended recipient can
decrypt it. This keeps the contents of your internet traffic completely private. Even your internet
service provider won’t see it.

  Exploring the world doesn’t mean you have to change the way you use the internet. A VPN lets you
  use the internet as if you were still in your home country, no matter how far you travel.
* [Enjoy the content you want: streaming TV and music on a laptop.]
  
  ### While having fun
  
  A VPN lets you enjoy the sites and services you like without ISP throttling that could detract
  from your experience or outright blocking by your ISP or local Wi-Fi network.
* [Stay safe on public Wi-Fi: using a laptop in a coffee shop.]
  
  ### While on public Wi-Fi
  
  Connecting to public Wi-Fi hotspots like those in cafes, airports, and parks could leave your
  private information vulnerable. Using a VPN on your devices keeps you safe with strong encryption.
* [Devices for gaming. ]
  
  ### While gaming
  
  Using a VPN unlocks games, maps, skins, and other add-ons that might be restricted on your
  network. It also shields you from DDoS attacks and reduces ping and overall lag.
* [Download anonymously. Laptop with download icon.]
  
  ### While file-sharing
  
  P2P file sharing usually means that strangers can see your IP address and possibly track your
  downloads. A VPN keeps your IP address private, letting you download with increased anonymity.
* [Shopping browser window.]
  
  ### While shopping
  
  Some online stores show different prices to people in different countries. With a VPN, you can
  find the best deals in the world no matter where you’re shopping from.

## How does a VPN work?

To understand how a VPN works, it helps to first understand how your internet connection works
without one.

### Without a VPN

When you access a website without a VPN, you are being connected to that site through your internet
service provider, or ISP. The ISP assigns you a **unique IP address** that can be used to identify
you to the website. Because your ISP is handling and directing all your traffic, it can see which
websites you visit. And your activity can be linked to you by that unique IP address.

### With a VPN

When you connect to the internet with a VPN, the VPN app on your device (also called a **VPN
client**) establishes a secure connection with a **VPN server**. Your traffic still passes through
your ISP, but your ISP can no longer read it or see its final destination. The websites you visit
can no longer see your original IP address, only the IP address of the VPN server, which is shared
by many other users and changes regularly.
* Not Connected Connected
* [What is a VPN? image.][Laptop with an unsecured connection to the internet with an eye looking at
  traffic data between the laptop and the internet.]

Here are several key concepts related to VPN that will help you understand how a VPN works and the
benefits it provides:

### Proxying

The VPN server acts like a **proxy**, or stand-in, for your web activity: Instead of your real IP
address and location, websites you visit will only see the IP address and location of the VPN
server.

This makes you more **anonymous** on the internet.

### Authentication

Establishing a secure connection is a tricky problem solved by clever mathematics in a process
called **authentication**.

Once authenticated, the VPN client and VPN server can be sure they are talking to each other and no
one else.

### Tunneling

VPNs also protect the connection between client and server with tunneling and encryption.

Tunneling is a process by which each data packet is **encapsulated** inside another data packet.
This makes it harder for third parties to read in transit.

### Encryption

Data inside the tunnel is also **encrypted** in such a way that only the intended recipient can
decrypt it. This keeps the contents of your internet traffic completely private. Even your internet
service provider won’t see it.

speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

evidence-backed timelines. Experience faster and more precise investigations, increasing team
productivity.

Monitor behavior of both employees and AI agents to gain visibility into this new class of insider
threat. User and entity behavior analytics (UEBA) and Agent Behavior Analytics (ABA) automatically
baseline activity, exposing anomalies that signal an actionable threat.

### [C100 OTP] [ One Time Passwords - OTP ][9]

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
The traditional form of 2FA and widely used, are OTP tokens . OTP tokens use one-time passwords,   
called One-Time Passwords (OTP). FIDO Security provides OTP tokens where a code is displayed at the
touch of a button to be entered into the application.                                              
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[ Get OTP tokens ][10]



### [ FIDO authentication ][11]

FIDO authentication is based on public-key encryption, which means that it does not have the
inherent vulnerabilities of OTPs sent over insecure networks. With the Feitian BioPass, a simple
fingerprint is even enough to log in securely to many applications.

[ Get FIDO tokens ][12]

### Passwords are a pain…
### for you and your customers.

** But there is a better way— FIDO! ** FIDO lets users log in easily, without the hassle of
passwords! And without the risks. FIDO is built into the devices we use every day, so logging in
with FIDO is safe, easy …and secure.

The FIDO security keys from Feitian work with hundreds of enterprise, developer and consumer
applications, out-of-the-box and with no client software. Combined with leading password managers,
social login and enterprise single sign on systems FIDO enables secure access to millions of online
services.

#### That’s why FIDO is the future of logins.

#### 
#### 
#### ** Why ePass FIDO? **

With ePass FIDO from Feitian Technologies, you can log in securely to many applications anytime,
anywhere.

ePass is the secure FIDO2 key for modern 2-factor authentication, multi-factor, and passwordless
authentication. Based on cryptography with public keys. The keys remain completely secret on the
security stick. Biometrics, if used, never leaves the token.

Replaces weak passwords with powerful hardware-based authentication to protect you from phishing,
session hijacking, man-in-the-middle, and malware attacks.


#### 
#### **
#### Where to use FIDO? **

The Feitian ePass FIDO can be used as additional authentication for almost any application or
application.

Works on any computer platform like a USB keyboard, smart card and smart card reader - no driver
needs to be installed. An unlimited number of services with one token.

Works seamlessly with many applications and platforms, such as Windows, Citrix, VMware View, DUO,
LastPass, Facebook, Google, GitHub, Dropbox, Amazon Web Services, Salesforce, and 1Password. With
Windows 10 and native support in Edge, all Microsoft consumer accounts are now supported with a
passwordless login via FIDO2.

#### 
#### 
#### ** How does that work? **

The ePass uses the FIDO2 open authentication standard. The multi-protocol ePass FIDO security keys
contain strong two-factor, multi-factor, and passwordless authentication.

The FIDO tokens add a second authentication layer. That works very easily, no passwords to enter -
replaces text messages, authenticator apps, OTP tokens and similar devices. Key in the computer, or
hold against the cell phone, touch, and ready.

Designed for phones and computers, for many forms of authentication and with different communication
methods, including USB and NFC.

# End-to-end fraud prevention and fraud orchestration

That doesn’t disrupt your customers
[ Watch Video ][18]

## Introducing a single platform to secure your digital customer journeys

Solution > **Udentify**

Defining, **Who is Your Customer**

Know the real identity of your Customer, User, Employee, Business Partners, Patient, Student, Player
& gamer in seconds when opening an account or onboarding.

Udentify’s biometric identity suite combines AI facial and voice recognition coupled with passive
liveness detection, delivering an unmatched anti-spoofing identity and reusable biometrics solution
across mobile, web, and telephone channels.

Udentify simplifies and protects the user’s entire transaction lifecycle, minus the friction and any
fraud.

[ DISCOVER MORE ][19]
[customer journey1]
[customer journey2]

Solution > **Udentify**

Effortless **Passwordless Authentication**

Loved by users loathed by fraudsters.

Only you can access your services with a simple scan of your face or a few spoken words, or both
together for that ultimate authentication. It’s secure, fast, frictionless, and cheaper to operate
than the ageing, less secure password systems we’ve grown to dislike.

Forget your passwords; be you!

[ DISCOVER MORE ][20]

Solution > **aiReflex**

Determining **which Transactions are legitimate**

An omnichannel, high-performance, white box AI-based fraud prevention suite that helps financial
institutions identify and prevent complex fraud scenarios and reduce false positives.

aiReflex analyses transactions and behavioural patterns in real-time to identify fraudulent
transactions.

[ DISCOVER MORE ][21]

[customer journey4]

Solution > **fcase**

How **to Respond** **to threats**

Fighting fraud requires collaboration, a single customer view.

fcase fraud orchestration forms a central intelligence on existing anti-fraud investments, further
reducing fraud and operational costs while driving the customer risk and trust journey.

[ DISCOVER MORE ][22]

## One Platform Solving many Problems

## Improving Customer Experience

Many organisations create terrible customer experiences at account creation and login, delivering
extreme friction and unnecessary fraud. The customer craves simplicity with a consistent experience
across all channels while being protected against fraud.

With fraud.com, customers can seamlessly signup and sign in to services with ease using their face,
voice or both using AI and genuine presence technology across all your business channels.
Furthermore, when transacting, our ML fraud prevention layers, coupled with fraud orchestration,
deliver extreme protection with zero friction.

## Reducing
## Fraud

Fraud.com sits in the background making it saffer for your customer to open an account, authenticate
or transact, with zero friction and minimum fraud and when your customer needs to interact we are
their to authenticate the real customer in under 1 second

## Increase Profitability

Fraud.com reduces the time and complexity when opening an account or onboarding while eliminating
fraud, thus gaining more valid customers.

When the customer is on board, they can access the service via a simple, seamless biometric
authentication platform that is natural to use, reducing friction, fraud and delivering long term
customer retention coupled with reduced IT overheads.

When the customer uses the service, our fraud detection – machine learning algorithms coupled with a
single view of the customer via fraud orchestration, reduce fraud and false positives, thus less
customer challenge-response required maintaining customer trust.

Furthermore, with a single view of fraud via fraud orchestration, fraud investigation is over 10x
more efficient.

## Reducing
## Costs

The total cost of fraud spans a wide area and has many moving parts:
* Fraud losses
* Fraud prevention tools and headcount
* Customer lifetime value impact: A customer who is impacted by fraud and friction and decides to
  take their business elsewhere.

journey, reducing fraud, false positives, friction, customer complaints, extreme operational
efficiencies, and associated costs across the board using the united fraud.com paradigm.

Defining, **Who is Your Customer**

Know the real identity of your Customer, User, Employee, Business Partners, Patient, Student, Player
& gamer in seconds when opening an account or onboarding.

Udentify’s biometric identity suite combines AI facial and voice recognition coupled with passive
liveness detection, delivering an unmatched anti-spoofing identity and reusable biometrics solution
across mobile, web, and telephone channels.

Udentify simplifies and protects the user’s entire transaction lifecycle, minus the friction and any
fraud.

reducing fraud and operational costs while driving the customer risk and trust journey.

extreme friction and unnecessary fraud. The customer craves simplicity with a consistent experience

voice or both using AI and genuine presence technology across all your business channels.

## Fraud

or transact, with zero friction and minimum fraud and when your customer needs to interact we are
their to authenticate the real customer in under 1 second

Fraud.com reduces the time and complexity when opening an account or onboarding while eliminating
fraud, thus gaining more valid customers.

authentication platform that is natural to use, reducing friction, fraud and delivering long term
customer retention coupled with reduced IT overheads.

single view of the customer via fraud orchestration, reduce fraud and false positives, thus less
customer challenge-response required maintaining customer trust.

Furthermore, with a single view of fraud via fraud orchestration, fraud investigation is over 10x
more efficient.

## Reducing
## Costs

* Fraud losses

## Frequently Asked Questions

How do credits work across different API?

We use a unified credit system. Simple requests like DNS Lookup, TLS Scan, Scraping cost **1
credit**. Advanced requests like Screenshotting, or PDF generation cost **5 credits**. You have one
pool of credits for all our APIs. Read more about [how credit works][28].

Does the Scraping API handle JavaScript & SPAs?

Yes, you can add `renderJS: true` in request payload to render JavaScript.

What happens after I use my free credits?

The free tier renews every month. If you need more, you can upgrade to a paid plan starting at
**$19/mo.**

How many concurrent requests can I send?

The Free plan allows **1** concurrent request. The Growth plan allows **10**, and the Business plan
allows **25**. If you need enterprise-grade concurrency (**1000+**), please contact us.

## How We Work

#### Primary Research

The primary research is performed by taking the interviews of executives of various companies
dealing in the market as well as using the survey reports, research institute, and latest research
reports. Meanwhile, analyst team keeps preparing set of questionnaires and after getting appointee
list; the target audience are then tapped and segregated with various mediums and channels that are
feasible for making connection.

#### Secondary Research

The secondary resources considered for the study include company annual reports, press releases,
published articles of organizations and associations, and the survey taken through different
mediums. In addition, the valuable strategic information obtained from industry association, paid
database, and investor presentations are also good tool for information to make appropriate
iterative validation are used to modify market models and cross-verify primary research and
insights.

[images]

#### Data Validation

Once the primary & secondary research phase is completed, the collected information is framed
stating a view point of current market status. The most important question is the ongoing scenarios
of the market and correlating recent development activity; this must be utilized before any
player/manufacturer can go and formulate business plans and strategic tactics.

#### Report Compilation

Our research methodology is a built-in philosophy of quality assurance & control and continuing
improvement is integral to the HTF Market Intelligence culture. Each analyst team bears final
responsibility for the quality and accuracy of their reports. This is achieved through a process of
cross-verification and comparison among alternative estimators. Estimates are thus verified and
refined to help guarantee superior, accurate results for our clients.

## Common questions about Inteca

## What is Inteca?

**Inteca** is a specialized enterprise platform provider based in Wrocław, Poland and a Red Hat
Advanced Partner. We design, implement, and operate mission-critical open-source platforms for large
enterprises.
We run a full enterprise open-source stack built on Red Hat, Keycloak, Apache Kafka, Nuxeo, and
Sparx Systems, delivering secure, compliant, and highly available managed platforms for regulated
industries such as banking, insurance, and government across the EU and the US.
On top of this platform stack, we provide AI-driven automation through our PractIQ product to
accelerate and govern enterprise software delivery and operations..

## What services and products does Inteca offer?

Inteca provides end-to-end managed services (“Project, Implement, Maintain”) across six core areas:
* **Identity & Access Management** based on **Keycloak** (SSO, MFA, federation, self-service)
* **Enterprise Messaging** using **Apache Kafka** (Strimzi and Red Hat Streams)
* **Contenerisation and orchestration with Managed** **Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes**
* **Business & Document Automation** with **Nuxeo**
* **Enterprise Architecture** using **Sparx Enterprise Architect**
* **AI Automation** through our proprietary **PractIQ** platform

## How Inteca support NIS 2 / KSC compliance?

The NIS 2 directive requires european organisations to implement ICT risk management measures —
including centralized identity and access management, multi-factor authentication, and comprehensive
security event logging.

# **Multi-factor authentication**

**MULTIFACTOR** — two-factor authentication and access control system for any remote connection:
RDP, VPN, VDI, SSH and others.

[
How to start?
][10][
Presentation
][11]

# Convenient solution, reliable protection

Multifactor — multi-factor authentication system for websites, Linux servers, Windows servers,
virtualization systems and clouds, Exchange, VPN, VDI and many corporate applications. Easily
integrates into any process and authenticates your users using the most modern and secure
authentication methods.

# Advantages

### Reduces risks by 99%

Using a second factor of authentication, according to statistics, reduces the likelihood of hacking
by 99%.

### Reduces costs

Multifactor costs tens of times less compared to enterprise solutions and the cost of their
implementation.

### Works on the Zero Trust principle

Multifactor does not receive your users' passwords. Strengthens protection without creating new
security risks.

### Simply solves complex problems

Multifactor works across all possible access protocols: Radius, LDAP, SAML, OAuth, API without
deploying a separate infrastructure.

### Fast start

Your users will configure their own authentication the first time they log in. Without registering.
Everything works in the browser, without installing plugins, drivers or third-party applications.

# Possibilities

## Different authentication methods

Mobile application, Telegram, biometrics, one-time code - you choose the available methods, and your
users use the most convenient ones available.

## Administrator's personal account

In your personal account you can manage users, settings, access objects and authentication methods.

## Access Policy and Log

Multifactor provides the ability to flexibly configure your users' access policies based on roles,
and all successful and unsuccessful access attempts will be recorded in a log available in the
administrator's personal account.

## With Multifactor you can
* Strengthen the security of your data
* Find out who, when and where access is accessed
* Find out who is using access unauthorized, including former employees
* Increase the loyalty of your users
* Protect the processes of logging in, changing passwords, restoring access and other significant
  actions
* Connect to your workplace using your fingerprint from your laptop

# It's time to ensure safety

The average hacker is not the hacker that Interpol is looking for, but an ordinary employee of an
organization who has been leaking personal, commercial and financial data to the outside world for
years. He earns a little money, but the organization loses clients and partners and receives less
profit. Are you sure this is not your organization?

# **Multi-factor authentication**

**MULTIFACTOR** — two-factor authentication and access control system for any remote connection:
RDP, VPN, VDI, SSH and others.

[
How to start?
][10][
Presentation
][11]

# Convenient solution, reliable protection

Multifactor — multi-factor authentication system for websites, Linux servers, Windows servers,
virtualization systems and clouds, Exchange, VPN, VDI and many corporate applications. Easily
integrates into any process and authenticates your users using the most modern and secure
authentication methods.

# Advantages

### Reduces risks by 99%

Using a second factor of authentication, according to statistics, reduces the likelihood of hacking
by 99%.

### Reduces costs

Multifactor costs tens of times less compared to enterprise solutions and the cost of their
implementation.

### Works on the Zero Trust principle

Multifactor does not receive your users' passwords. Strengthens protection without creating new
security risks.

### Simply solves complex problems

Multifactor works across all possible access protocols: Radius, LDAP, SAML, OAuth, API without
deploying a separate infrastructure.

### Fast start

Your users will configure their own authentication the first time they log in. Without registering.
Everything works in the browser, without installing plugins, drivers or third-party applications.

# Possibilities

## Different authentication methods

Mobile application, Telegram, biometrics, one-time code - you choose the available methods, and your
users use the most convenient ones available.

## Administrator's personal account

In your personal account you can manage users, settings, access objects and authentication methods.

## Access Policy and Log

Multifactor provides the ability to flexibly configure your users' access policies based on roles,
and all successful and unsuccessful access attempts will be recorded in a log available in the
administrator's personal account.

## With Multifactor you can
* Strengthen the security of your data
* Find out who, when and where access is accessed
* Find out who is using access unauthorized, including former employees
* Increase the loyalty of your users
* Protect the processes of logging in, changing passwords, restoring access and other significant
  actions
* Connect to your workplace using your fingerprint from your laptop

# It's time to ensure safety

The average hacker is not the hacker that Interpol is looking for, but an ordinary employee of an
organization who has been leaking personal, commercial and financial data to the outside world for
years. He earns a little money, but the organization loses clients and partners and receives less
profit. Are you sure this is not your organization?

# Fuel Your Performance

For more than 35 years, Optimum Nutrition has been supporting athletes and fitness lovers to unlock
their best selves with premium-quality nutrition and proven performance formulas.

[Visit Official Store][9]

## Our Story

From humble beginnings to a global sports nutrition leader.

Founded in 1986, Optimum Nutrition was created with one mission: to deliver consistent, trusted, and
effective nutrition that helps people of all fitness levels reach their goals with confidence.

From our world-renowned Gold Standard 100% Whey to our cutting-edge pre-workouts and supplements, we
continue to lead the way in quality, innovation, and performance worldwide.

## Our Core Values

Driven by science. Trusted by athletes. Built for performance.

### Proven Quality

Every ON product is tested for purity, potency, and consistency to meet the highest global standards
in sports nutrition.

### Science-Based Innovation

We combine leading nutritional science with advanced manufacturing techniques to deliver products
powered by results.

### Commitment to Excellence

From the ingredients we source to the athletes who trust us, excellence defines every stage of our
journey.

## Our Journey

Decades of dedication and performance.

1986

#### Brand Foundation

Optimum Nutrition was founded with the goal of giving athletes access to the highest-quality protein
and sports nutrition available anywhere.

2004

#### The Gold Standard Era

Launch of Gold Standard 100% Whey Protein, which quickly became the most recognized and trusted
protein powder in the world.

2025

#### A Future of Sustainable Performance

ON introduces eco-conscious packaging and continues advancing nutrition through clean, effective
formulas that respect both health and the planet.

## Classic Products

### Gold Standard 100% Whey

The world’s best-selling whey protein powder, offering 24g of premium protein per serving to support
muscle recovery and growth. Trusted by athletes around the world for its taste, quality, and proven
results.

### Serious Mass

A powerhouse gainer formula designed to help you build strength and mass the right way. Packed with
calories, protein, and essential nutrients, Serious Mass supports intense training and performance
goals.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers about product use, safety, and nutrition tips.

01

### Are Optimum Nutrition products tested for quality?

Yes. All ON products are produced in GMP-certified facilities and undergo rigorous testing for
safety, purity, and potency.

02

### When should I take whey protein?

Whey protein can be taken post-workout for muscle recovery or anytime during the day to help meet
your daily protein needs.

03

### Is Serious Mass suitable for beginners?

Yes. Serious Mass is perfect for those aiming to gain healthy weight or increase calorie intake
alongside strength training.

04

### Where can I buy genuine ON products?

Visit the official website or authorized online and retail partners to ensure authenticity and
product quality.

# Fuel Your Performance

For more than 35 years, Optimum Nutrition has been supporting athletes and fitness lovers to unlock
their best selves with premium-quality nutrition and proven performance formulas.

## Our Story

From humble beginnings to a global sports nutrition leader.

Founded in 1986, Optimum Nutrition was created with one mission: to deliver consistent, trusted, and
effective nutrition that helps people of all fitness levels reach their goals with confidence.

From our world-renowned Gold Standard 100% Whey to our cutting-edge pre-workouts and supplements, we
continue to lead the way in quality, innovation, and performance worldwide.

## Our Core Values

Driven by science. Trusted by athletes. Built for performance.

### Proven Quality

Every ON product is tested for purity, potency, and consistency to meet the highest global standards
in sports nutrition.

### Science-Based Innovation

We combine leading nutritional science with advanced manufacturing techniques to deliver products
powered by results.

### Commitment to Excellence

From the ingredients we source to the athletes who trust us, excellence defines every stage of our
journey.

## Our Journey

Decades of dedication and performance.

1986

#### Brand Foundation

Optimum Nutrition was founded with the goal of giving athletes access to the highest-quality protein
and sports nutrition available anywhere.

2004

#### The Gold Standard Era

Launch of Gold Standard 100% Whey Protein, which quickly became the most recognized and trusted
protein powder in the world.

2025

#### A Future of Sustainable Performance

ON introduces eco-conscious packaging and continues advancing nutrition through clean, effective
formulas that respect both health and the planet.

## Classic Products

### Gold Standard 100% Whey

The world’s best-selling whey protein powder, offering 24g of premium protein per serving to support
muscle recovery and growth. Trusted by athletes around the world for its taste, quality, and proven
results.

### Serious Mass

A powerhouse gainer formula designed to help you build strength and mass the right way. Packed with
calories, protein, and essential nutrients, Serious Mass supports intense training and performance
goals.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers about product use, safety, and nutrition tips.

01

### Are Optimum Nutrition products tested for quality?

Yes. All ON products are produced in GMP-certified facilities and undergo rigorous testing for
safety, purity, and potency.

02

### When should I take whey protein?

Whey protein can be taken post-workout for muscle recovery or anytime during the day to help meet
your daily protein needs.

03

### Is Serious Mass suitable for beginners?

Yes. Serious Mass is perfect for those aiming to gain healthy weight or increase calorie intake
alongside strength training.

04

### Where can I buy genuine ON products?

Visit the official website or authorized online and retail partners to ensure authenticity and
product quality.

FAQ

## You ask, we answer

Cloud Services
Cyber Security
Data Center Solutions
Digital Transformation

IMS
What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

Features

## Everything you need.
## Nothing you don't.

A full suite of remote PC controls, built into one clean app.

Wake on LAN
Wake your PC from anywhere — at home or across the world. No hardware required beyond your existing
router.
Power Control
Shutdown, restart, sleep, or lock your PC remotely with one tap. Confirm before executing so you
never do it by accident.
Media Controls
Play, pause, skip, and control volume. See what's playing with album art — works with Spotify,
YouTube, and any media player.
Clipboard Sync
Copy something on your phone, paste it on your PC. Or grab your PC's clipboard from your phone —
instant, bidirectional sync.
File Browser
Browse, search, and download files from your PC directly to your phone. No cloud required — all
local.
System Monitor
Live CPU, RAM, GPU, and disk stats streamed to your phone. Know what your PC is doing without being
at your desk.
Screenshot
Capture your PC screen and view it on your phone instantly. Tap to zoom, pinch to inspect, save to
camera roll.
Scheduled Events
Set your PC to wake up, run apps, and shut down on a schedule. Automate your whole workflow without
lifting a finger.
Soundboard
Play audio files through your PC speakers from your phone. Great for streaming, content creation, or
just messing around.
How it works

## Up and running
## in under 2 minutes.

No complicated network setup. No port forwarding required for basic use. Just download, scan, and
go.

1
Download the Agent
Install the free PCLink Agent on your Windows PC. It runs silently in your system tray — no account
required.
2
Open the App
Download PCLink on your iPhone or Android. Tap the + button to add a new device.
3
Scan the QR Code
A pairing window appears on your PC automatically. Scan the QR code with your phone — they're
connected instantly.
4
Control from anywhere
That's it. Your PC is now accessible from your phone over WiFi, mobile data, or any network —
securely and privately.
Download

## Get started for free.

PCLink is free to download. Unlock all features with a one-time Pro upgrade — no subscription, ever.

PCLink Agent
The Windows companion app that runs on your PC. Required to connect your phone. Free, lightweight,
and runs in the system tray.

Can anyone else control my PC?
No. When you pair your phone, a unique security token is generated and stored only on your device.
Every command requires this token — it is never exposed or transmitted outside your encrypted
connection. Even someone on your network cannot control your PC without it.
Does PCLink collect any of my data?
None at all. No analytics, no tracking, no third-party SDKs that collect data. Everything stays
between your phone and your PC. We don't have servers that see your commands or files.
Does it work away from home?
Yes. PCLink connects through a secure relay so it works anywhere — on mobile data, at school, at
work. Your PC just needs to be on with the agent running. Wake on LAN from outside your home

Wake on LAN requires a wired Ethernet connection and must be enabled in your PC's BIOS under Power

# Support

We're here to help.

## Common Issues

**PC shows as offline**
Make sure the PCLink Agent is running in your Windows system tray (bottom-right of taskbar). Try
right-clicking the tray icon and selecting Restart Agent. Check that both your phone and PC have
internet access.

**Wake on LAN not working**
WoL requires a wired Ethernet connection and must be enabled in BIOS under Power Management
settings. It does not work over Wi-Fi on most PCs. Your PC also needs to remain plugged into power.

**Can't pair my device**
Make sure the agent is running and showing a QR code. Codes expire after 5 minutes — if it's
expired, right-click the tray icon and select Pair / Repair Device to generate a new one. Try
entering the 6-digit code manually if the QR scan fails.

**Commands are slow or not working**
Check your internet connection on both your phone and PC. If the PC shows online but commands fail,
try restarting the agent from the system tray.

## Contact

If you're still having trouble, reach out and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

[ support@pclink.app ][11]

# Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 2025

PCLink is designed with your privacy as a core principle. We do not collect, store, transmit, or
sell your personal data.

## What We Don't Collect

We do not collect your name, email address, location, device identifiers, usage analytics, crash
reports, or any other personal information. No data is sent to our servers — because your commands
never pass through servers we control.

## Local Communication

The app communicates with the PCLink Agent on your PC through an encrypted WebSocket connection
relayed through a secure server. The relay server facilitates the connection but does not store,
log, or inspect the content of your commands.

## Security Tokens

When you pair your phone with a PC, a unique security token is generated and stored locally on your
device. This token is used only to authenticate commands. It is never transmitted to any third
party.

## Third-Party Services

PCLink does not integrate with any analytics platforms, advertising networks, or third-party data
processors. No third-party SDKs that collect user data are included in the app.

## Data Storage

All app data — paired devices, custom actions, scheduled events, settings — is stored locally on
your device using on-device storage. You can delete this data at any time by removing the app.

## Children's Privacy

PCLink is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

## Changes

If we make material changes to this policy, we will update the date above. We encourage you to
review it periodically.

## Contact

Questions about this Privacy Policy? Email us at [support@pclink.app][12].

# Terms of Use

Last updated: May 2025

By downloading or using PCLink, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the
app.

## Description

PCLink is a remote PC control application that allows you to send commands to a Windows PC running
the PCLink Agent from your mobile device.

## Use at Your Own Risk

Commands like shutdown and restart take effect immediately on your PC. You are solely responsible
for ensuring commands are sent intentionally. PCLink is not liable for any data loss or other
consequences resulting from use of the app.

## Permitted Use

You may use PCLink only to control PCs you own or have explicit permission to control. Unauthorized
use to access another person's computer without consent may violate applicable law.

## No Warranty

The app is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We do not warrant that the app will be
error-free or uninterrupted.

## Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, PCLink and its developer shall not be liable for any
indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the app.

## Intellectual Property

All content, design, and code within the app is the intellectual property of PCLink. You may not
copy, modify, or reverse engineer any part of the app without prior written permission.

## Contact

Questions? Email [support@pclink.app][13].

# Support

We're here to help.

## Common Issues

**PC shows as offline**
Make sure the PCLink Agent is running in your Windows system tray (bottom-right of taskbar). Try
right-clicking the tray icon and selecting Restart Agent. Check that both your phone and PC have
internet access.

**Wake on LAN not working**
WoL requires a wired Ethernet connection and must be enabled in BIOS under Power Management
settings. It does not work over Wi-Fi on most PCs. Your PC also needs to remain plugged into power.

**Can't pair my device**
Make sure the agent is running and showing a QR code. Codes expire after 5 minutes — if it's
expired, right-click the tray icon and select Pair / Repair Device to generate a new one. Try
entering the 6-digit code manually if the QR scan fails.

**Commands are slow or not working**
Check your internet connection on both your phone and PC. If the PC shows online but commands fail,
try restarting the agent from the system tray.

If you're still having trouble, reach out and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

[ support@pclink.app ][11]

# Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 2025

PCLink is designed with your privacy as a core principle. We do not collect, store, transmit, or
sell your personal data.

## What We Don't Collect

We do not collect your name, email address, location, device identifiers, usage analytics, crash
reports, or any other personal information. No data is sent to our servers — because your commands
never pass through servers we control.

## Local Communication

The app communicates with the PCLink Agent on your PC through an encrypted WebSocket connection
relayed through a secure server. The relay server facilitates the connection but does not store,
log, or inspect the content of your commands.

## Security Tokens

When you pair your phone with a PC, a unique security token is generated and stored locally on your
device. This token is used only to authenticate commands. It is never transmitted to any third
party.

## Third-Party Services

PCLink does not integrate with any analytics platforms, advertising networks, or third-party data
processors. No third-party SDKs that collect user data are included in the app.

## Data Storage

All app data — paired devices, custom actions, scheduled events, settings — is stored locally on
your device using on-device storage. You can delete this data at any time by removing the app.

## Children's Privacy

PCLink is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

## Changes

If we make material changes to this policy, we will update the date above. We encourage you to
review it periodically.

You may use PCLink only to control PCs you own or have explicit permission to control. Unauthorized

error-free or uninterrupted.

## award-winning, enterprise-ready, open source 2FA system

## privacyIDEA receives Open Source Business Award

### The open source two factor authentication system privacyIDEA receives the Open Source Business
### Award for an innovative, enterprise ready, mature open source product.

[Read more.][49]

## privacyIDEA wins THOMAS-KRENN Award

### The open source two factor authentication system privacyIDEA wins 2nd place in Thomas Krenn
### Award for promising and outstanding open source projects.

[Read more.][50]

## Two factor authentication at it's best.

### privacyIDEA is the community open source two factor server. It is a flexible authentication
### system, managing all kinds of tokens, OTP and more ...

[read more.][51]

## API everywhere

### Simple REST API with JWT authentication. Plays well with other systems.

[See the API.][52]

## Written in Python.

### Modular design and rapid development. Easy to join!

[Join now!][53]

## Do the speech.

### We are lucky to get translations for any language.

[See how to contribute.][54]

### Authentication System privacyIDEA

privacyIDEA is a modular authentication server that can be used to enhance the security of your
existing applications like local login, VPN, remote access, SSH connections, access to web sites or
web portals with two factor authentication. Originally it was used for OTP (One Time Password)
authentication devices – being an OTP server. But other “devices” like challenge response, U2F,
Yubikeys, SSH keys and x509 certificates are also available. It runs on Linux and is completely Open
Source, licensed under the AGPLv3.

Go for privacyIDEA to setup Multi-Factor-Authentication for your most precious services and keep the
control.

### Openness and Transparency

privacyIDEA tries to be open in many ways. We try to provide best transparency: We host our code on
github, so that you can monitor the development. The issue tracker at Github is used, so that you
can see, which topic is hot, what is coming up in the future and actually add your own requests! You
are welcome to fork and issue pull requests and we are happy to accept those. You becoming a part of
this project.

New features are planned on github. We are using travis-ci.org to run our tests. You can see which
tests pass and also which test fail! Yes, code breaks and tests fail.

privacyIDEA is not ruled by a single company (although at the moment only one company is involved).
Thus when using privacyIDEA or getting involved you are not at the mercy of one single, revenue
driven decision maker.

### Technical

privacyIDEA can read users from many different sources like LDAP services, Active Directory, SQL
databases, flat files and SCIM services.

Authentication devices to provide two factor authentication can be assigned to those users, either
by administrators or by the users themselves. Policies define what a user is allowed to do in the
selfservice portal and what an administrator is allowed to do in the management interface.

The system is written in Python, uses Flask as web framework and an SQL database as datastore. Thus
it can be enrolled quite easily providing a lean installation.

See a [detailed list of features][55].

You want to understand how privacyIDEA works? We offer a webinar in May 2026.
* **privacyIDEA and Passkeys (07.05.2026, 5:00 pm – 5:45 pm CEST)**

Register [here][56].

Do you want colors and pixels? You can find them [here][57].

If you want to be part of the community visit our [community forum][58].

In addition privacyIDEA supports users in SCIM servers,

## award-winning, enterprise-ready, open source 2FA system

## privacyIDEA receives Open Source Business Award

### The open source two factor authentication system privacyIDEA receives the Open Source Business
### Award for an innovative, enterprise ready, mature open source product.

[Read more.][49]

## privacyIDEA wins THOMAS-KRENN Award

### The open source two factor authentication system privacyIDEA wins 2nd place in Thomas Krenn
### Award for promising and outstanding open source projects.

[Read more.][50]

## Two factor authentication at it's best.

### privacyIDEA is the community open source two factor server. It is a flexible authentication
### system, managing all kinds of tokens, OTP and more ...

[read more.][51]

## API everywhere

### Simple REST API with JWT authentication. Plays well with other systems.

[See the API.][52]

## Written in Python.

### Modular design and rapid development. Easy to join!

[Join now!][53]

## Do the speech.

### We are lucky to get translations for any language.

[See how to contribute.][54]

### Authentication System privacyIDEA

privacyIDEA is a modular authentication server that can be used to enhance the security of your
existing applications like local login, VPN, remote access, SSH connections, access to web sites or
web portals with two factor authentication. Originally it was used for OTP (One Time Password)
authentication devices – being an OTP server. But other “devices” like challenge response, U2F,
Yubikeys, SSH keys and x509 certificates are also available. It runs on Linux and is completely Open
Source, licensed under the AGPLv3.

Go for privacyIDEA to setup Multi-Factor-Authentication for your most precious services and keep the
control.

### Openness and Transparency

privacyIDEA tries to be open in many ways. We try to provide best transparency: We host our code on
github, so that you can monitor the development. The issue tracker at Github is used, so that you
can see, which topic is hot, what is coming up in the future and actually add your own requests! You
are welcome to fork and issue pull requests and we are happy to accept those. You becoming a part of
this project.

New features are planned on github. We are using travis-ci.org to run our tests. You can see which
tests pass and also which test fail! Yes, code breaks and tests fail.

privacyIDEA is not ruled by a single company (although at the moment only one company is involved).
Thus when using privacyIDEA or getting involved you are not at the mercy of one single, revenue
driven decision maker.

### Technical

privacyIDEA can read users from many different sources like LDAP services, Active Directory, SQL
databases, flat files and SCIM services.

Authentication devices to provide two factor authentication can be assigned to those users, either
by administrators or by the users themselves. Policies define what a user is allowed to do in the
selfservice portal and what an administrator is allowed to do in the management interface.

The system is written in Python, uses Flask as web framework and an SQL database as datastore. Thus
it can be enrolled quite easily providing a lean installation.

See a [detailed list of features][55].

You want to understand how privacyIDEA works? We offer a webinar in May 2026.
* **privacyIDEA and Passkeys (07.05.2026, 5:00 pm – 5:45 pm CEST)**

Register [here][56].

Do you want colors and pixels? You can find them [here][57].

If you want to be part of the community visit our [community forum][58].

In addition privacyIDEA supports users in SCIM servers,
